steps.what: List missing records whose consent flag is set
Guide clients in the gathering of information
Review disability insurance, pension plans, and wills
Sign the gathering note
File the signed gathering note
outputs: filed copy of signed gathering note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DATA_PLATFORM} lists a record only when the stored consent flag is set and the record is still missing. The advisor guides the client in gathering bank account records, income tax returns, life and disability insurance records, pension plans, or wills. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not read a record without that flag.
tasks.previous_blocker: Records were chased from memory, including files the client had not agreed to share.
tasks.enabler_now: Consent flag, record type, and record identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Guiding the client stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides which missing record to ask for next.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client, not on the missing list.

reach.task: Share only what the signed note names

evidence.claim: The executive digest says gathering data is an integration, not a model.

assumptions: Consent flag, record type, and record identifier are stored on the source record. The source record produces them. A record is read only when the stored consent flag is set. A blank consent flag means the record is not read. A blank record type is not requested.
Native configuration of the source record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor guiding clients in the gathering of information.

incremental.description: Refresh consent flag, record type, and record identifier when the source layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many consent flags are blank. The high end assumes consent flag and record type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor market figures against the plan.

steps.what: Show stored market figures against the client plan
Monitor financial market trends against client plans
Decide whether the plans stay responsive
Sign the market note
File the signed market note
outputs: filed copy of signed market note v1

tasks.design: A job in {BI} shows stored market figures against the client plan and draws no chart by hand. The advisor monitors the trends and decides whether the plans stay responsive. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not change the plan by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Market figures were copied onto a chart before the plan was reviewed.
tasks.enabler_now: Market identifier, figure amount, and plan amount are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The judgement stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides whether the plan should change.

ambition.what: Sign the market note the day a stored market figure and the plan differ.

tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week on the judgement, not on drawing the chart.

reach.task: Discuss only the market note the advisor signed

evidence.claim: The executive digest says dashboards replace drawing charts.
Digest [S10] says most models in a published test ended a cash waterfall at the wrong figure. This design checks every figure against a source row.

assumptions: Market identifier, figure amount, and plan amount are stored on the market record. The market record produces them. A blank figure is not treated as zero. The dashboard does not change the plan.
Native configuration of the market record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor monitoring financial market trends against client plans.

incremental.description: Refresh market identifier, figure amount, and plan amount when the market layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many market figures are blank. The high end assumes figure amount and plan amount are both stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit clients without a hidden list.

steps.what: List prospect names the advisor already stored
Recruit and maintain client bases in person
Decide who is asked, with no hidden list
Sign the recruitment note
File the signed recruitment note
outputs: filed copy of signed recruitment note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CRM} lists only prospect names the advisor already stored and writes no score. The advisor recruits and maintains the client bases. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not build a secret list of people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Names were kept in a side list the advisor no longer controlled.
tasks.enabler_now: Prospect name is stored only when the advisor has already entered it.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides who is asked.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week recruiting, not on listing names.

reach.task: Hear only from the advisor, about the signed note

evidence.claim: Digest [S20] says a fraud list held people without legal basis. This design does not build a secret list of people.

assumptions: Prospect name is stored only when the advisor already entered it on the prospect record. The prospect record produces it. A blank name is not added. The list is not a score and is not a secret list of people.
Native configuration of the prospect record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor recruiting and maintaining client bases.

incremental.description: Refresh prospect name when the prospect layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many prospect names are blank. The high end assumes prospect name was entered by the advisor. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the stored meeting with the other advisors
Meet clients' other advisors to understand their goals
Meet attorneys, accountants, and trust officers
Discuss financial circumstances with investment bankers
Sign the meeting note
File the signed meeting note
outputs: filed copy of signed meeting note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists the stored meeting. The advisor meets the client's other advisors, including attorneys, accountants, trust officers, and investment bankers, and works to understand the financial goals and circumstances. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. It does not attend the meeting.
tasks.previous_blocker: The meeting happened with no stored date and no note of who attended.
tasks.enabler_now: Meeting date and advisor role are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The conversation stays with the advisor.
tasks.human_edge: The advisor decides what those conversations mean for the plan.
tasks.altitude: The advisor spends the week in the meeting, not on the list.

reach.task: Speak only with the advisor, against the signed note

evidence.claim: The meeting stays with the advisor. A stored list does not attend it.

assumptions: Meeting date and advisor role are stored on the calendar record. The calendar record produces them. A blank date is not a meeting. The advisor attends.
Native configuration of the calendar record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the advisor signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the advisor meeting the client's other advisors.

incremental.description: Refresh meeting date and advisor role when the calendar layout changes, and drop a note the advisor has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many meeting dates are blank. The high end assumes meeting date and advisor role are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The advisor spends the week with the client and on the signed note. A stored ratio, a missing-field list, and filing that signature can move. The advisor still interviews, recommends, and decides.
reach: A client receives only the text the advisor signed.
A creditor is paid only the disbursement the advisor signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a ratio that treats a blank figure as zero.
Reject a report whose figure has no source row.
Reject a payment the advisor has not signed.
role.ambitious_version: A signed plan note can be filed the same day, and the advisor still decides the strategy.
